html: Instrument page titles now state the licence answer instead of asking a question. A title reads, for example, PHQ-9: free for employers to use. Licence and evidence | OWHS, WEMWBS: paid licence needed for employer use. Licence and evidence | OWHS or UWES-9: permission needed for employer use. Licence and evidence | OWHS, generated from the same per-class wording as the descriptions. Where a record's licence class is unverified, or the name is too long for the answer to fit, the title uses a neutral form that asserts nothing. No grade, status or licence class changed.
